acceptance: Implement deterministic plan-envelope readiness and admission-result evaluation within core/modules/task-control.
Implement dependency classification and invalidation facts without silently changing scope, ordering, reservation, budget, or task status.
Implement atomic per-component and bounded parent-allocation reservation acquisition, release, stale-owner recovery, orphan handling, and no-partial-admission behavior.
Preserve or extend fail-closed parent-closure evaluation so non-terminal, failed, cancelled, unintegrated, or unaccounted descendants cannot produce successful closure.
Add focused provider-free deterministic checks while preserving existing task-control regression behavior and current contracts.
